name: jorap-com
description: JoRap Notes - personal blog and portfolio (Hugo + Tailwind).
author: JoRap

scripts.dev: concurrently "node scripts/themeGenerator.js --watch" "node scripts/noteFileDates.js --watch" "node scripts/hugoServer.mjs server --source website --buildDrafts --buildFuture -e development --baseURL=http://localhost:1313/"
scripts.preview: node scripts/themeGenerator.js && node scripts/noteFileDates.js && npm run hugo:prod-server
scripts.update-modules: node ./scripts/clearModules.js && node scripts/hugoServer.mjs mod --source website clean --all && node scripts/hugoServer.mjs mod --source website get -u ./... && node scripts/hugoServer.mjs mod --source website tidy
scripts.lint:garden: node scripts/runPython.mjs scripts/lint-notes-frontmatter.py && node scripts/runPython.mjs scripts/normalize-notes-format.py --verify && node scripts/runPython.mjs scripts/lint-flashcard-frontmatter.py && node scripts/runPython.mjs scripts/audit-flashcard-north-star.py && node scripts/runPython.mjs scripts/lint-utility-wikilinks.py && node scripts/runPython.mjs scripts/lint-faith-garden.py --check && node scripts/runPython.mjs scripts/voice-lint.py garden --check && node scripts/runPython.mjs scripts/audit-notes-b1.py --check && node scripts/runPython.mjs scripts/voice-lint.py slop --check --notes-only
scripts.lint:voice: node scripts/runPython.mjs scripts/voice-lint.py dashes --check && node scripts/runPython.mjs scripts/voice-lint.py site --check
scripts.lint:blog: node scripts/runPython.mjs scripts/normalize-blog-frontmatter.py --verify && node scripts/runPython.mjs scripts/voice-lint.py slop --check --blog-only && node scripts/runPython.mjs scripts/audit-blog-b1.py --check && node scripts/blog-voice-lint.mjs --check && node scripts/lint-alex-eala-headings.mjs
